news.title: Apple Suffers Worst Rout Since 2025 on Disappointing Outlook
news.description: Apple Inc. suffered its worst stock decline in 16 months after component shortages weighed on the company’s sales forecast, signaling that industrywide supply constraints are taking a bigger toll than anticipated.

news.title: Roblox Shares Slump on Safety-Measures Impact, Weak Forecast
news.description: Roblox Corp. shares tumbled nearly 27%, their largest single-day decline ever, after the gaming company reported second-quarter daily active users that missed analysts’ expectations, reflecting the ongoing impact of new child-safety measures.

news.title: Amazon Shares Soar Most Since 2012 on Cloud Sales Growth
news.description: Amazon.com Inc. shares surged the most since 2012 after the company reported accelerating cloud-computing revenue, easing investors’ concerns that it won’t produce a return on huge expenditures to meet the booming demand for artificial intelligence.

腾讯云发布智能数据湖计算 AI DLC，打通数据处理到 Agent 应用全流程
news.description:
从数据处理到 Agent 的链路正在被大幅压缩。

7月30日，记者获悉，腾讯云正式发布智能数据湖计算平台AI DLC，面向自动驾驶、具身智能、Agent等AI场景，提供覆盖数据处理、训练、推理到 Agent 应用的一体化能力。以腾讯自研的 WorkBuddy 为例，接入 AI DLC 后，其处理同一批数据的端到端时间缩短80%，完成相同任务所需算力约为此前的五分之一。

news.title: REDMI K100 Pro Max 官宣小米首款 185Hz 电竞屏，旗舰触控芯片
news.description:
IT之家 8 月 1 日消息，小米今日公布 REDMI K100 Pro Max 部分性能配置，新机将于 8 月 11 日晚 7 点发布。

据介绍，该机搭载小米首款 185Hz 高刷电竞屏，原生适配 30+ 热门游戏；第五代骁龙 8 至尊版 +AI 独显芯片 D2，支持游戏超帧超分并发；旗舰触控芯片，采样率升级至 480Hz；游戏专属天线，时延大幅降低；Sound by Bose 游戏调音，枪声、脚步增强。
